text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the first day of summer camp. It's a period of intense training where racers can improve their skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Or so it should be, but Hishi Akebono only has eyes for watermelon splitting, flowing noodles, and other fun activities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That said, she does promise to work hard during training. I guess it won't be all work and no play during this hot summer camp!
